Phase 2: Scout where your material lives

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 2 "Phase 2: Scout where your material lives": line 31: "It is what the door is about to decide." The pronoun binds to "the list" in the previous sentence; "the door" is named in chunk 0 (line 7). Closest to violating: line 15 "the bet you just wrote" is a session artifact from the preceding exercise write-the-bet (produces team/bet.md), exempt.

chunk 0: line 7 "Before anything goes in, ..." and line 59 "Next, each of you builds your memory through that door." point at the next beat by title-free sequence, not by file position; no "the opening lecture said" shape. Closest: line 15 "the bet you just wrote" names the artifact by content.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 1: line 15 "the bet you just wrote" resolves to apt101-write-the-bet.md, which produces team/bet.md (grep "bet.md" there: line 11 and 100). Line 41 "the three scouting lists" resolves to Phase 2 of this file. No "the X you caught" dead callback.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess-before-reveal demo beat; prompts are task instructions

rules_evaluated.evidence: Smallest chunk 4 "Take stock of the door" lines 51-59 carries a recap (line 55 "One door, agreed by all three of you, written down before anything went in") and a pointer; self-carrying, not a wait-state.

chunk 3 "Phase 3: Agree the door": line 41 "asks Claude to write the door" and line 47 "Anyone may say no" match the header; chunk 1 header "Pin the bet in your own folder" matches line 15 ./challenge.md. No contradiction.

Closest: line 15 "What you're trying, what you already know, where you are stuck." is a clause list naming three contents of a brief, each concrete, not a verb triplet; line 45 list of four material kinds is an enumeration. grep for "Not X. Not Y." shape: none; no superlatives; no number+retraction; no abstraction-noun stacks.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -nE "\b(above|below|beat|surface|firing)\b" on body (lines 1-59) -> 0 hits (hits only at lines 66,70 in maintainer block). "door" is the training's own earned term, defined at line 7 and 39.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Bold in body: line 5 "**What you do:**", line 53 "**What happened:**", line 57 "**What's next:**". All are standard exercise labels (<=3 words), no lead sentences bolded; chunk 4 carries two label handles, which the exercise recap template mandates. Closest: line 57.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: File is an exercise included by modules/our-product-our-system.md:56 ("[Exercise: What goes in](exercises/apt101-what-goes-in.md)"), so its phase wrappers reach the composed deck; all four ## sections sit in the exercise phase.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Headings: "Phase 1: Pin the bet in your own folder", "Phase 2: Scout where your material lives", "Phase 3: Agree the door" (phase labels), "Take stock of the door" (imperative). Exercise grammar; no law/consolidation slide owes a claim.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: line 21 "That difference is the point; three agents will read three briefs." adds the consequence (three agents, three briefs) not stated in the slide's other bullets, so not a pure restating kicker; line 47 "That is the door working." explains why the cost of a lost source is acceptable. Line 55 recap is the template What happened slot.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No ## heading appears retitled over inherited bullets: every body line under chunks 1-4 answers its own header (e.g. chunk 4 line 55 recaps the door, matching "Take stock of the door"). No maintainer provenance note of the shape "(from <old-file>, header his)" (grep -c "from .*header" maintainer block -> 0).

notes: Maintainer block carries no slides accept-notes; only the Quality stamp line (L63). Prompt bodies via {{prompt:}} markers not judged here (fences exempt).
